entries.en: The museum displayed a tomahawk beside a carefully drawn historical map.
entries.zh: 博物馆在一幅精心绘制的历史地图旁展出了一把短柄战斧。

entries.en: Her constancy gave the struggling team confidence during a difficult season.
entries.zh: 在艰难的赛季中，她的坚定不移给了这支处境困难的球队信心。

entries.en: After years in academe, he accepted a job at a museum.
entries.zh: 在学术界工作多年后，他接受了一份博物馆的工作。

entries.en: The historical record listed larceny among the charges against the prisoner.
entries.zh: 这份历史记录将盗窃罪列为针对该囚犯的指控之一。

entries.en: The cello added a lugubrious note to the otherwise cheerful performance.
entries.zh: 大提琴为这场原本欢快的演出增添了一丝忧郁的色彩。

entries.en: The thin branches bent flexibly under the weight of the snow.
entries.zh: 细枝在积雪的重量下柔软地弯曲着。

entries.en: A pinkish glow spread across the clouds just before sunrise.
entries.zh: 日出前，云层泛起了一片淡粉红色的光。

entries.en: The council controversially approved a tower beside the old market.
entries.zh: 市议会批准在老市场旁建一座高楼，此举引发了争议。

entries.en: Golly, I never expected the little garden to look this beautiful!
entries.zh: 天哪，我从没想到这个小花园会这么漂亮！

entries.en: A heavy clod of earth fell from the gardener's spade.
entries.zh: 一大块泥土从园丁的铁锹上掉了下来。

entries.en: Her repeated requests for quieter music went unheeded throughout the evening.
entries.zh: 她反复请求调低音乐音量，但整个晚上都没人理会。

entries.en: Loose scree slid beneath our boots as we crossed the slope.
entries.zh: 我们横穿山坡时，松散的碎石在靴子下面滑动。

entries.en: The open gate allowed unimpeded access to the riverside path.
entries.zh: 敞开的大门让人可以畅通无阻地进入河边小路。

entries.en: The laboratory inventory listed benzene in a separate section for chemicals.
entries.zh: 实验室的库存清单在单独的化学品一栏中列出了苯。

entries.en: The novel ends with the knight mortally wounded outside the castle.
entries.zh: 小说结尾时，那名骑士在城堡外受了致命伤。

entries.en: The café serves a quintessentially French breakfast of coffee and croissants.
entries.zh: 这家咖啡馆供应咖啡配羊角面包的典型法式早餐。

entries.en: She tried to disassociate her charity from the misleading advertisements.
entries.zh: 她试图使自己的慈善机构与那些误导性广告撇清关系。

entries.en: The printer took an inordinately long time to produce one page.
entries.zh: 这台打印机打印一页纸花了长得离谱的时间。

entries.en: He checked the clock compulsively while waiting for the interview.
entries.zh: 等待面试时，他不由自主地一遍遍看钟。

entries.en: The tiny boat balanced improbably on top of the enormous wave.
entries.zh: 那艘小船在巨浪顶上竟能保持平衡，令人难以置信。

entries.en: She acted honourably by returning the prize after discovering the mistake.
entries.zh: 发现错误后，她退还了奖品，表现得光明磊落。

entries.en: The film portrays an exorcism in a remote mountain village.
entries.zh: 这部电影描绘了一个偏远山村里的一场驱魔仪式。

entries.en: The dustman waved to the children before emptying the last bin.
entries.zh: 垃圾清运工清空最后一个垃圾桶前向孩子们挥了挥手。

entries.en: The ground beside the stream stayed boggy long after the rain.
entries.zh: 雨停很久后，溪边的地面仍像沼泽一样泥泞。

entries.en: The two schools are administratively separate despite sharing the same campus.
entries.zh: 这两所学校虽然共用一个校园，但在行政管理上相互独立。

entries.en: The guide packed a compass and the other accoutrements of exploration.
entries.zh: 向导装好了指南针和其他探险装备。

entries.en: There was some unpleasantness over the bill before everyone finally left.
entries.zh: 大家最后离开前，因为账单发生了一点争执。

entries.en: The festival brought a welcome spillover of visitors to neighboring villages.
entries.zh: 这个节庆带来了可喜的外溢效应，让邻近村庄也迎来了游客。

entries.en: An undated letter lay between the pages of her grandfather's diary.
entries.zh: 一封未注明日期的信夹在她祖父的日记里。

entries.en: He smiled smugly after finding the error everyone else had missed.
entries.zh: 发现其他人都没注意到的错误后，他自鸣得意地笑了。

entries.en: The documentary exposed the maltreatment of animals at the abandoned farm.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片揭露了那座废弃农场虐待动物的情况。

entries.en: A postcard from Italy dropped through our letterbox this morning.
entries.zh: 今天早晨，一张来自意大利的明信片从我家的投信口投了进来。

entries.en: The initiator of the project invited neighbors to the first meeting.
entries.zh: 该项目的发起人邀请邻居们参加第一次会议。

entries.en: We ordered a large pizza topped with pepperoni and green peppers.
entries.zh: 我们点了一张上面放着意大利辣香肠和青椒的大比萨。

entries.en: The play's narrator describes his uncle as a lonely drunkard.
entries.zh: 剧中的叙述者把他的叔叔描述为一个孤独的酒鬼。

entries.en: The detective noticed a bloodstained sleeve in the film's opening scene.
entries.zh: 在电影开场的那一幕中，侦探注意到了一只沾有血迹的袖子。

entries.en: A clockwork automaton raised its wooden arm whenever the bell rang.
entries.zh: 每当铃声响起，一个发条机械人偶就会举起木制手臂。

entries.en: The salesman launched into his usual spiel about the vacuum cleaner.
entries.zh: 销售员开始滔滔不绝地讲起推销那台吸尘器的惯用说辞。

entries.en: She placed her inhaler in the small pocket of her bag.
entries.zh: 她把自己的吸入器放进了包里的小口袋。

entries.en: The mother cat lay quietly while she suckled her three kittens.
entries.zh: 母猫静静地躺着，给三只小猫喂奶。

entries.en: She booked a pedicure at the salon before her beach holiday.
entries.zh: 去海边度假前，她在美容院预约了一次足部护理。

entries.en: His freshly shaven head gleamed under the bright dressing-room lights.
entries.zh: 在化妆间明亮的灯光下，他刚剃过的光头闪闪发亮。

entries.en: The paint remover loosened the old coating on the wooden door.
entries.zh: 脱漆剂使木门上的旧涂层松动了。

entries.en: The donkey obstinately refused to leave the shade of the tree.
entries.zh: 那头驴固执地不肯离开树荫。

entries.en: The two dialects are linguistically similar but have different social histories.
entries.zh: 这两种方言在语言学上相似，但社会历史不同。

entries.en: She dismissed the grand promises as humbug after reading the details.
entries.zh: 看过细节后，她认为那些宏大的承诺都是骗人的话。

entries.en: A red hibiscus flower opened beside the entrance to the courtyard.
entries.zh: 院门旁开出了一朵红色的木槿花。

entries.en: The office shredder jammed when someone fed it a thick envelope.
entries.zh: 有人把一个厚信封塞进去时，办公室的碎纸机卡住了。

entries.en: The old abattoir outside town has been converted into artists' studios.
entries.zh: 城外那座旧屠宰场已被改建成艺术家工作室。

entries.en: Leaving the children alone beside the busy road was inexcusable.
entries.zh: 把孩子们独自留在繁忙的路边是不可原谅的。

entries.en: The twins were dressed identically in blue coats and red scarves.
entries.zh: 这对双胞胎穿着完全相同，都穿蓝外套、戴红围巾。

entries.en: She added a smiley to the message to show she was joking.
entries.zh: 她在消息里加了一个微笑表情，表示自己是在开玩笑。

entries.en: The beastly smell from the drain drove everyone out of the kitchen.
entries.zh: 排水管里令人作呕的气味把大家都熏出了厨房。

entries.en: Closing the entire playground seemed an overreaction to one broken swing.
entries.zh: 仅仅因为一个秋千坏了就关闭整个游乐场，似乎反应过度了。

entries.en: We carried our takeaway meals to a bench beside the river.
entries.zh: 我们把外卖餐带到了河边的一张长椅旁。

entries.en: He strapped his surfboard to the roof before driving to the beach.
entries.zh: 开车去海滩前，他把冲浪板绑在了车顶上。

entries.en: The butcher kept the offal in a tray behind the counter.
entries.zh: 肉贩把动物内脏放在柜台后面的一个托盘里。

entries.en: The new pupil timidly asked whether the seat beside me was free.
entries.zh: 新来的学生羞怯地问我旁边的座位是否有人坐。

entries.en: In the drama, a footman announces each guest at the doorway.
entries.zh: 在这部戏中，一名男仆在门口通报每位来客的到来。

entries.en: The ratchet clicked as she tightened the strap around the crate.
entries.zh: 她收紧箱子外的绑带时，棘轮装置咔嗒作响。

entries.en: He used a scraper to lift dried paint from the window.
entries.zh: 他用刮刀把窗户上干掉的油漆刮下来。

entries.en: She experienced the excitement vicariously through her brother's lively travel stories.
entries.zh: 通过哥哥生动的旅行故事，她也间接感受到了那份激动。

entries.en: The wartime memoir describes a batman polishing the officer's muddy boots.
entries.zh: 这本战争回忆录描写了一名勤务兵擦拭军官沾满泥的靴子。

entries.en: The children's show featured zany costumes and an enormous dancing carrot.
entries.zh: 这档儿童节目有滑稽古怪的服装，还有一根巨大的跳舞胡萝卜。

entries.en: The workshop builds numeracy through shopping games and simple number puzzles.
entries.zh: 这个工作坊通过购物游戏和简单的数字谜题培养计算能力。

entries.en: The display included ceremonial headgear decorated with bright feathers and beads.
entries.zh: 展品中包括用鲜艳羽毛和珠子装饰的仪式头饰。

entries.en: The miller weighed the grist before pouring it into the hopper.
entries.zh: 磨坊主把待磨的谷物倒进料斗前先称了重。

entries.en: The dog began to salivate when it smelled the roast chicken.
entries.zh: 闻到烤鸡的香味时，那条狗开始流口水。

entries.en: The coachman pulled the horses to a halt outside the inn.
entries.zh: 马车夫在客栈外勒住马，让车停了下来。

entries.en: The retired pitman donated his helmet to the local mining museum.
entries.zh: 那位退休煤矿工人把自己的头盔捐给了当地矿业博物馆。

entries.meaningZh: 细鳞大麻哈鱼；用于称呼人时有冒犯性，不应用来称呼他人
entries.en: A male humpback struggled upstream through the shallow water to spawn.
entries.zh: 一条雄性细鳞大麻哈鱼奋力穿过浅水，逆流而上去繁殖。

entries.en: Critics saw his sudden change of position as political opportunism.
entries.zh: 批评者认为他突然改变立场是政治上的投机取巧。

entries.en: The travelers rested by the fire and planned their journey for the morrow.
entries.zh: 旅人们在火边休息，安排次日的行程。

entries.en: After two glasses of wine, he felt tipsy and unusually talkative.
entries.zh: 两杯葡萄酒下肚后，他有些微醉，话也格外多。

entries.en: We found a welcoming hostelry at the far end of the village.
entries.zh: 我们在村子尽头找到了一家热情好客的旅店。

entries.en: The old emporium sold everything from kitchen utensils to garden furniture.
entries.zh: 那家老百货商店从厨房用具到花园家具，什么都卖。

entries.meaningZh: 孩子到朋友家过夜的聚会
entries.en: My daughter packed her pajamas for a sleepover at her friend's house.
entries.zh: 女儿收好睡衣，准备去朋友家参加过夜聚会。

entries.en: The medical textbook includes a short chapter on sinusitis and related terminology.
entries.zh: 这本医学教材有一小章介绍鼻窦炎及相关术语。

entries.en: The restored altarpiece shows three figures beneath a painted golden arch.
entries.zh: 修复后的祭坛装饰画描绘了彩绘金色拱门下的三个人物。

entries.en: A thin white pinstripe ran down each side of his dark trousers.
entries.zh: 他的深色长裤两侧各有一条细细的白色条纹。

entries.en: The crematorium stands in quiet gardens a short distance from town.
entries.zh: 火葬场坐落在离城镇不远的一片宁静花园中。

entries.en: The puppy waggled its ears as the children gathered around.
entries.zh: 孩子们围过来时，小狗来回动着耳朵。

entries.en: He pulled the wooden bung from the barrel with some difficulty.
entries.zh: 他费了些力气，才把木塞从桶上拔下来。

entries.en: The essay challenges a mechanistic view of human thought and behavior.
entries.zh: 这篇文章质疑用机械论看待人类思维和行为的观点。

entries.en: She gave me a quizzical look when I arrived carrying three umbrellas.
entries.zh: 我带着三把伞到达时，她疑惑地看了我一眼。

entries.en: The report identified suffocation as the cause of death in the accident.
entries.zh: 报告认定窒息是这起事故中的死亡原因。

entries.en: The conductor thanked the orchestra for its punctuality throughout the rehearsals.
entries.zh: 指挥感谢乐团在整个排练期间都很守时。

entries.en: An orangutan reached for a branch above the forest observation platform.
entries.zh: 一只红毛猩猩伸手去够森林观察平台上方的树枝。

entries.en: She unplugged the lamp before moving the table across the room.
entries.zh: 她把桌子搬到房间另一边之前，先拔掉了台灯的插头。

entries.en: The fantasy story features a bloodthirsty ruler obsessed with endless battles.
entries.zh: 这个奇幻故事中有一位痴迷于无休止战争的嗜血统治者。

entries.en: Her brother was a relentless teaser who enjoyed hiding her slippers.
entries.zh: 她哥哥总爱戏弄人，喜欢把她的拖鞋藏起来。

entries.en: The undersized box could not hold all the books we had packed.
entries.zh: 箱子太小，装不下我们打包好的所有书。

entries.en: A stingray glided over the sand beneath the aquarium's glass tunnel.
entries.zh: 一条黄貂鱼在水族馆玻璃隧道下方的沙地上方滑行。

entries.en: The delicatessen on the corner sells olives, cheese, and fresh sandwiches.
entries.zh: 街角的熟食店出售橄榄、奶酪和新鲜三明治。

entries.en: The botanist compared the plant's generative organs under a microscope.
entries.zh: 植物学家在显微镜下比较了这种植物的生殖器官。

entries.en: The topmost shelf held a row of dusty jars and bottles.
entries.zh: 最上层的架子上放着一排落满灰尘的罐子和瓶子。

entries.en: The baker flavored the little biscuits with crushed anise seeds.
entries.zh: 面包师用碾碎的茴芹籽给小饼干调味。

entries.en: A honeybee hovered above the lavender before landing on a flower.
entries.zh: 一只蜜蜂在薰衣草上方盘旋，随后落在一朵花上。

entries.en: The novel questions the village's puritanical attitudes toward dancing and entertainment.
entries.zh: 这部小说质疑村民对舞蹈和娱乐所持的过分拘谨的道德态度。

entries.en: The final photograph poignantly captures the empty chair beside the window.
entries.zh: 最后一张照片拍下窗边的空椅子，令人感到辛酸。

entries.en: Her explanation stood out for its lucidity despite the complicated subject.
entries.zh: 尽管主题复杂，她的讲解仍以清晰明了而显得出众。

entries.en: The original recording was irretrievably lost when the archive burned down.
entries.zh: 档案馆被大火烧毁时，原始录音也永远丢失，无法挽回。

entries.en: Her aunt played matchmaker by inviting them both to dinner.
entries.zh: 她姑妈把他们两人都请来吃晚餐，借此牵线搭桥。

entries.en: Calling the small delay a disaster was clearly an overstatement.
entries.zh: 把这点小延误称为灾难，显然是夸大其词。

entries.en: The graph demonstrates proportionality between the quantities shown on its axes.
entries.zh: 这张图展示了两条坐标轴所表示数量之间的比例关系。

entries.meaningZh: 最低限度或保守的行动
entries.en: The committee's minimalism produced only minor repairs instead of a complete renovation.
entries.zh: 委员会采取最低限度行动的做法，只促成了小修小补，而非全面翻修。

entries.en: The guard refused admittance to visitors without a valid appointment.
entries.zh: 警卫不允许没有有效预约的访客进入。

entries.en: The exhibition traces the development of cartography from hand-drawn maps to satellite mapping.
entries.zh: 这场展览追溯了从手绘地图到卫星制图的发展历程。

entries.en: The empty studio gave the young artist untrammelled freedom to experiment.
entries.zh: 空旷的工作室给了这位年轻艺术家不受限制的实验自由。

entries.en: A criminologist examined patterns in the town's historical crime records.
entries.zh: 一位犯罪学家研究了这个城镇历史犯罪记录中的规律。

entries.en: The concert ended memorably with every musician joining the final chorus.
entries.zh: 音乐会以所有乐手共同加入最后的合唱而结束，令人难忘。

entries.en: The seedlings grew healthily in the bright greenhouse throughout the spring.
entries.zh: 整个春天，幼苗都在明亮的温室里健康生长。

entries.en: The ball struck the goalpost and bounced back onto the field.
entries.zh: 球撞上球门柱，又弹回了场内。

entries.en: The essay presents the novelist as a moralist concerned with everyday choices.
entries.zh: 这篇文章把那位小说家描写成一位关注日常抉择的道德论者。

entries.en: It was galling to lose the race after leading for so long.
entries.zh: 领先了那么久却输掉比赛，实在令人恼火。

entries.en: A regular churchgoer, my neighbor often helps arrange the Sunday flowers.
entries.zh: 我的邻居经常去教堂礼拜，也常帮忙摆放星期日礼拜用的鲜花。

entries.en: The teacher's elucidation of the poem helped us understand its final image.
entries.zh: 老师对这首诗的阐释帮助我们理解了最后一个意象。

entries.en: After a sleepless night, she noticed a dullness in her thinking.
entries.zh: 一夜没睡之后，她感觉自己的思维有些迟钝。

entries.en: The comedy features a busybody who keeps interrupting the neighbors' conversations.
entries.zh: 这部喜剧中有个爱管闲事的人，总是打断邻居们的谈话。

entries.en: The team's anaemic performance disappointed supporters who had expected an exciting match.
entries.zh: 球队表现乏力，让原本期待一场精彩比赛的支持者们很失望。

entries.en: The room was agreeably cool after the heat of the street.
entries.zh: 从炎热的街道走进来，房间里的凉爽让人很舒服。

entries.en: In the story, the suspect spends one night in the village lockup.
entries.zh: 故事中，嫌疑人在村里的拘留所待了一夜。

entries.en: She stirred a spoonful of dark treacle into the cake mixture.
entries.zh: 她往蛋糕面糊中拌入了一勺深色糖蜜。

entries.en: The goalkeeper stoutly defended her team's tactics during the interview.
entries.zh: 采访中，守门员坚决为球队的战术辩护。

entries.en: With the bridge closed, our journey was perforce delayed until morning.
entries.zh: 桥关闭了，我们的行程只得推迟到早晨。

entries.en: She nobly offered her place in the lifeboat to another passenger.
entries.zh: 她把自己在救生艇上的位置让给了另一位乘客，表现得十分高尚。

entries.en: The local history book describes an herbalist who lived near the mill.
entries.zh: 这本地方史书描写了一位住在磨坊附近的草药医师。

entries.en: After his apprenticeship, he worked as a journeyman in several workshops.
entries.zh: 学徒期结束后，他作为熟练工人在几家作坊工作过。

entries.en: She tied a colorful kerchief over her hair before entering the garden.
entries.zh: 进花园前，她把一条彩色头巾系在头发外面。

entries.en: The queen beckoned the messenger hither and asked for news of the ships.
entries.zh: 女王示意信使到这里来，并询问船只的消息。

entries.meaningZh: 飞越；低空飞过指定地点
entries.en: The aircraft made a low flyby over the harbor during the ceremony.
entries.zh: 典礼期间，那架飞机低空飞越了港口。

entries.en: She spoke unreservedly about her disappointment with the unfinished exhibition.
entries.zh: 她毫无保留地表达了对这场未完成展览的失望。

entries.en: The organizer used a megaphone to call the runners to the start.
entries.zh: 组织者用扩音器招呼跑步选手们到起点集合。

entries.en: He watched the new puppy with undisguised delight as it explored the room.
entries.zh: 新来的小狗探索房间时，他毫不掩饰地开心地看着。

entries.en: The child greeted the photographer with a wide, toothy grin.
entries.zh: 孩子咧嘴露出牙齿，给了摄影师一个灿烂的笑容。

entries.en: The guard dog growled menacingly as the stranger approached the gate.
entries.zh: 陌生人走近大门时，看门狗发出了带有威胁的低吼。

entries.en: Our philosophy seminar explored ontology through questions about existence and identity.
entries.zh: 我们的哲学研讨课通过存在与同一性的问题探讨本体论。

entries.en: A groundhog disappeared into a burrow beneath the edge of the field.
entries.zh: 一只土拨鼠钻进田边的洞穴，不见了踪影。

entries.en: The old pamphlet dismissed people outside its religion as heathens.
entries.zh: 那本旧宣传册贬斥不信其宗教的人为异教徒。

entries.en: The equipment can multiplex several audio signals over a single cable.
entries.zh: 这套设备能通过一根电缆对多路音频信号进行复用传输。

entries.en: The painting gives the central figure a calm and godlike presence.
entries.zh: 这幅画赋予中心人物一种平静而神圣的气质。

entries.meaningZh: 抽彩赌博；赌金独得的抽奖
entries.en: Everyone drew a horse's name for the office sweepstake before the race.
entries.zh: 赛马开始前，大家各抽了一个马名，参加办公室的抽彩竞猜。

entries.en: A young cockerel strutted across the yard behind the red barn.
entries.zh: 一只小公鸡在红色谷仓后面的院子里昂首阔步。

entries.en: Her memoir describes the claustrophobia she experienced in crowded underground trains.
entries.zh: 她的回忆录描述了她在拥挤的地铁中感受到的幽闭恐惧。

entries.en: She opened the casement to let the evening breeze into the bedroom.
entries.zh: 她打开平开窗，让晚风吹进卧室。

entries.en: The museum acquired a masterwork from the painter's most productive period.
entries.zh: 博物馆购入了这位画家创作最旺盛时期的一幅杰作。

entries.en: Our elderly pooch prefers a quiet walk to chasing a ball.
entries.zh: 我们家的老狗更喜欢安静地散步，不太爱追球。

entries.en: Carved figures covered the stone sarcophagus in the center of the gallery.
entries.zh: 展厅中央的石棺上布满了雕刻的人物。

entries.en: The lecture examined monopolistic control of the region's railway network.
entries.zh: 这堂课探讨了对该地区铁路网的垄断性控制。

entries.en: The repeated leaks revealed the ineffectiveness of the temporary roof repairs.
entries.zh: 屋顶反复漏水，表明临时修补没有起到作用。

entries.en: Her warmth and sociability helped new residents feel at home.
entries.zh: 她的热情和善于交际让新住户感到自在。

entries.meaningZh: 鹰派的；主张强硬政策的
entries.en: The historian compared hawkish speeches with calls for a negotiated settlement.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了鹰派言论与呼吁通过谈判解决问题的主张。

entries.en: The horse lifted its hind leg, showing a white patch near the hock.
entries.zh: 马抬起后腿，露出了跗关节附近的一块白斑。

entries.en: We explored the city during a six-hour stopover between our flights.
entries.zh: 在两趟航班之间六小时的停留期间，我们游览了这座城市。

entries.en: The host poured a small dram of whisky for each guest.
entries.zh: 主人给每位客人倒了一小杯威士忌。

entries.en: Her green taffeta skirt rustled as she walked across the ballroom.
entries.zh: 她走过舞厅时，绿色塔夫绸裙子沙沙作响。

entries.en: The explorer's diary records a winter journey interrupted by severe frostbite.
entries.zh: 这位探险家的日记记载了一次因严重冻伤而中断的冬季旅行。

entries.en: The author's original typescript contained handwritten corrections in the margins.
entries.zh: 作者的原始打字稿页边留有手写的修改。

entries.en: The historian portrayed the king as an absolutist who rejected parliamentary limits.
entries.zh: 历史学家把那位国王描述为一个拒绝议会限制的专制主义者。

entries.en: We spent the rainy afternoon watching a crappy old science-fiction movie.
entries.zh: 那个下雨的下午，我们看了一部蹩脚的老科幻电影。

entries.en: The railwayman checked his watch as the freight train entered the station.
entries.zh: 货运列车进站时，那位铁路职工看了看手表。

entries.en: The newly discovered letters offered a revelatory glimpse of her early friendships.
entries.zh: 新发现的书信揭示了她早年的友谊，令人获得新的认识。

entries.en: A bright blue flag fluttered from the flagpole beside the school.
entries.zh: 一面鲜蓝色的旗帜在学校旁的旗杆上飘扬。

entries.en: The fishmonger arranged the morning's catch on a bed of ice.
entries.zh: 鱼贩把早晨捕来的鱼摆在一层冰上。

entries.en: The committee mismanaged the project and lost track of several important deliveries.
entries.zh: 委员会对这个项目管理不善，没能掌握几批重要货物的交付情况。

entries.en: The organist played a fugue while the audience settled into their seats.
entries.zh: 观众陆续落座时，管风琴师演奏了一首赋格曲。

entries.en: The mineral's green fluorescence became visible under the ultraviolet lamp.
entries.zh: 在紫外线灯下，这种矿物发出的绿色荧光变得可见。

entries.en: The geology class examined a dark mineral sample containing manganese.
entries.zh: 地质课上，学生们观察了一块含锰的深色矿物样本。

entries.en: He felt like a prat after waving enthusiastically at the wrong person.
entries.zh: 热情地朝错认的人挥手后，他觉得自己像个傻瓜。

entries.en: The ploughman guided his team slowly along the edge of the field.
entries.zh: 扶犁人赶着牲口，沿着田边缓慢前行。

entries.meaningZh: 大男子气概；逞强的男子气
entries.en: The film questions the machismo that prevents its hero from admitting fear.
entries.zh: 这部电影质疑那种让男主角不肯承认恐惧的大男子气概。

entries.en: The exhibition documents the enslavement of people and their struggle for freedom.
entries.zh: 这场展览记录了人们遭受奴役以及争取自由的斗争。

entries.en: A regular attender at the meetings offered to organize the next one.
entries.zh: 一位经常参加会议的人主动提出组织下一次会议。

entries.en: The refiner supplied processed metal to several factories in the region.
entries.zh: 这家精炼厂商向该地区几家工厂供应加工后的金属。

entries.en: The contest rules made entries submitted after midnight inadmissible.
entries.zh: 比赛规则规定，午夜之后提交的作品不予接受。

entries.en: He furtively slipped the birthday card beneath his sister's bedroom door.
entries.zh: 他偷偷把生日贺卡从妹妹卧室门下塞了进去。

entries.en: She drew a thin line of eyeliner along her upper eyelid.
entries.zh: 她沿上眼睑画了一条细细的眼线。

entries.en: Steep cliffs rose on both sides of the narrow blue fjord.
entries.zh: 狭窄的蓝色峡湾两侧耸立着陡峭的悬崖。

entries.en: The juggler kept five bright balls in the air above his head.
entries.zh: 杂耍演员让五个鲜艳的球在头顶上方接连飞舞。

entries.en: The attic held a conglomeration of broken furniture, old toys, and suitcases.
entries.zh: 阁楼里杂乱地堆着坏家具、旧玩具和行李箱。

entries.en: The biology diagram labels the anus at the end of the digestive tract.
entries.zh: 这张生物学示意图在消化道末端标出了肛门。

entries.en: Several unclaimed umbrellas remained in the station's lost-property office.
entries.zh: 车站失物招领处还留着几把无人认领的雨伞。

entries.en: The toddler pointed at the doggy sleeping beside the kitchen door.
entries.zh: 幼儿指着那只睡在厨房门旁的狗狗。

entries.en: He rested the freshly written letter on a blotter before folding it.
entries.zh: 他把刚写好的信放在吸墨纸垫上，然后才折起来。

entries.en: The voyager recorded unfamiliar islands in a small leather-bound notebook.
entries.zh: 那位远航者把陌生的岛屿记在一个皮面小本子里。

entries.en: The picnic set includes lightweight, unbreakable cups in four different colors.
entries.zh: 这套餐具中有四种颜色的杯子，轻便又不易打碎。

entries.en: The fishing boats turned seaward as the morning mist began to lift.
entries.zh: 晨雾开始散去时，渔船转向了大海。

entries.en: The lovers arranged a secret tryst beneath the old garden bridge.
entries.zh: 这对恋人约好在花园的旧桥下秘密幽会。

entries.en: They keep goats and grow vegetables on their smallholding outside town.
entries.zh: 他们在城外的小农场养山羊、种蔬菜。

entries.meaningZh: 足智多谋；随机应变的能力
entries.en: Her resourcefulness turned a broken ladder into shelves for the workshop.
entries.zh: 她灵机一动，把一架坏梯子改成了车间用的搁架。

entries.en: The agricultural course included a lecture on artificial insemination in cattle.
entries.zh: 这门农业课程包含一堂关于牛的人工授精的讲座。

entries.en: A fresh coat of paint would smarten the old garden gate.
entries.zh: 重新刷一层漆会让花园的旧门好看些。

entries.en: The children made a beeline for the swings as the gate opened.
entries.zh: 门一打开，孩子们就径直奔向秋千。

entries.en: His final paragraph was a reiteration of the argument in the introduction.
entries.zh: 他最后一段重申了引言中的论点。

entries.en: Years of working together created a strong sense of sisterhood among them.
entries.zh: 多年共事使她们之间产生了深厚的姐妹情谊。

entries.en: He caught his shirtsleeve on a nail sticking out of the fence.
entries.zh: 他的衬衫袖子被栅栏上伸出的钉子钩住了。
